description: issue #874: `new_turtle` is a Kind-R reporter taking 0 inputs (`spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:21`), so `(new_turtle 1 2)` reports `actual: 2` against `expected: 0`. Supplying TWO inputs rather than one is deliberate — it pins that the finding carries the real argument count rather than a hardcoded `1`, which a fixture that only ever over-supplies by one cannot distinguish. Check-only for the same reason as arity-paren-who-too-many: the runtime's call-time check does not yet reject an over-supplied zero-arity reporter.
